handoff.salientSummary: Implemented OpenCompass config generator for API models with dataset-specific inferencer settings. OpenAI config uses type=OpenAI, path=gpt-4 with env://OPENAI_API_KEY. Claude uses type=Anthropic with env://ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Qwen uses type=DashScope with env://DASHSCOPE_API_KEY. MMLU dataset uses PPLInferencer, HellaSwag uses GenInferencer. All 23 tests pass and code is committed.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Created OpenCompass config generator in internal/k8s/configmap/generator.go that generates MMEngine Python config files. Supports OpenAI (type=OpenAI, path=gpt-4, num_gpus=0), Claude (type=Anthropic, key from env), Qwen (type=DashScope, key from env). MMLU uses PPLInferencer, HellaSwag uses GenInferencer. API keys are injected via env://OPENAI_API_KEY style references. Enhanced tests with dataset-specific inferencer verification.
